data.long_meaning: The name Kamra is derived from the Arabic word ‘kamr’, which means ‘bottle’ or ‘jar’. In Arabic culture, the name Kamra is believed to symbolize the strength and resilience of a woman, as a bottle holds precious liquids and keeps them safe. The name Kamra carries the meaning “Bottle, Jar” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Kamra usually hope their child will grow to embody bottle, jar and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name is also linked to the preservation of precious substances, just as a bottle holds water and keeps it fresh for long periods of time.

Moreover, the name can inspire us to be like the bottle, consistently offering comfort and shelter to those around us.
